DensShield Drywall Tile Backer: The Ultimate Solution for Tile Installations

DensShield Drywall Tile Backer is a substrate for floor, wall, and ceiling ceramic tile installations, offering built-in moisture protection for wet areas such as bathrooms and kitchens. It’s the ideal ceramic tile underlayment for new construction, bathroom remodelling, pool areas, and many other high-humidity or wet areas. Incorporating fibreglass mats and a moisture-resistant core, DensShield drywall is lighter and easier to install than traditional cement board backers. It can also be painted or used in non-wet areas.

DensShield is GREENGUARD listed as microbial-resistant, providing an added layer of protection against mould and mildew growth. Its exceptional performance in mould resistance, as demonstrated by scoring the highest level under ASTM D 3273 testing, ensures a healthier indoor environment and prolongs the longevity of your tile installations. Shop DensShield Tile Backer for the reliability and peace of mind you need for a successful project.

Key Features of DensShield Drywall:

  • Built-in Moisture Barrier: Prevents moisture damage to tile installations and the wall cavity.
  • Mould Resistant: Achieves high levels of mould resistance, ensuring a clean and healthy environment.
  • Easy to Handle: Cuts and installs like drywall without special tools or fasteners, offering convenience during installation.
  • Versatile Application: Suitable for floors, walls, countertops, and ceilings, providing flexibility for various projects.
  • Convenient Sizes: Available in convenient sizes, including 5/8″ Type X board, for use in appropriate fire-rated assemblies.

Overall, the DensShield Tile Backer is an excellent choice for tile installations, offering durability, moisture protection, and ease of installation for both professionals and DIY enthusiasts. Shop DensShield drywall products online or visit one of FlooReno’s showrooms to buy.
